Don't think Ted mentions capitalism even once in ISAIF, could be wrong though. He shits on lefties quite a bit though. If you can't be bothered to read the whole thing, start from paragraph 99 on to the very end, (each paragraph is numbered) and if that piqued your interest, then read paragraphs 1 thru 98. 
Another good way to first get aquainted with Ted's body of work as a primer is to read 'The System's Neatest Trick', it is a very short essay (like eight to ten pages more or less) that you will no doubt appreciate if you're not down with globohomo and its consequences. He goes much more into the propaganda side of things in this essay, not so much into the tech stuff; can pretty much guarantee you've never read anything like it.
